title: Tree Search for LLM Agent Reinforcement Learning
authors_zh: Yuxiang Ji、Ziyu Ma、Yong Wang、Guanhua Chen、Xiangxiang Chu、Liaoni Wu
paper_type_zh: 在线 agent RL 树式 rollout 构造、隐式过程监督与发布审计研究
best_for_zh: 研究共享前缀 rollout、ReAct agent-step 信用分配、训练预算、程序化奖励和轨迹发布边界的读者
one_line: Tree-GRPO builds shared-prefix forests of complete ReAct agent steps during online RL, scores terminal leaves with EM/F1 and format rules, and derives intra-/inter-tree process signals, but it releases code rather than the raw trees, discarded branches, or reward lineage.
Tree-GRPO 在在线 RL 中构造共享前缀的 ReAct agent-step 树，以 EM/F1 与格式规则给终点叶子评分并形成树内/树间相对优势；官方发布提供实现代码，但未发布原始树、舍弃分支或逐记录奖励谱系。
why: It shows how search structure itself can turn a fixed token/tool budget into more agent trajectories and finer credit assignment, while exposing why parent-child lineage, all leaf outcomes, environment snapshots, split manifests, and retention decisions are necessary before such runtime trees can be treated as auditable reasoning data.
inclusion_reason: Tree-GRPO makes an online agent-RL rollout forest an explicit training-data object: complete ReAct steps form shared-prefix branches, programmatic outcome labels score leaves, and tree-relative groups convert terminal feedback into implicit process supervision under disclosed rollout budgets. Its in-memory-only trees and missing branch/reward release make it especially useful for auditing the boundary between a search recipe and reusable trace data.

title: Problem
问题
html:
Outcome-reward agent training has a credit-assignment problem. A search agent may take several complete ReAct steps—each combining a thought, textual search action, and retrieved observation—before producing an answer, yet an exact-match or F1 reward arrives only at the leaf. Ordinary GRPO groups independently sampled full chains for one prompt. Those chains consume their complete token and tool-call budgets separately, and a terminal group comparison does not expose which shared earlier decision separated a successful continuation from a failed one.

Tree-GRPO asks whether the rollout object can be structured so that outcome feedback supplies a more local training signal without a separately trained process reward model. It generates a prompt-conditioned forest whose nodes are complete thought-action-observation agent steps. Each tree begins as a full current-policy trajectory, then selected non-answer nodes become shared prefixes from which new suffixes are generated. Completed leaves carry terminal answers and programmatic outcome scores; tree membership allows the optimizer to compare related leaves within a tree as well as all leaves produced for the prompt.

The in-memory data object is richer than a list of answers. It includes the prompt and target, tree_uid and node_uid, parent-child pointers, depth, shared prefixes, generated responses, information and turn masks, validity/search statistics, terminal EM/F1-plus-format scores, and intra-tree/inter-tree relative advantages. The lineage is: source QA row → processed prompt and ground truth → current-policy ReAct forest → retrieval observations → completed leaves → programmatic outcome → tree-relative advantages → Tree-GRPO update.

This is a core case for Rollout, Search, and Test-Time Trace Data, even though the search occurs during online training rather than test-time inference. The topology, prefix reuse, expansion decisions, leaf retention, and rollout budget determine which traces enter the policy update and what supervision they carry. The public artifact boundary is crucial: the official repository releases construction and training code, but no official dataset of selected trajectories, raw trees, all branches, rejected leaves, per-record rewards/advantages, or replayable environment states was verified.

The Card is therefore an L4 bilingual recipe-and-audit record, not a claim that Tree-GRPO released a reusable reasoning-trace corpus. Citation, venue, paper, code, and implementation behavior are verified; status remains partial because the central runtime object is deleted rather than published, and its record-level provenance and reuse rights remain unresolved.

仅依赖结果奖励的 agent 训练存在信用分配问题。搜索 agent 在给出答案前可能执行多个完整 ReAct 步骤，每一步都包含 thought、文本搜索动作和检索观察，但 exact match 或 F1 奖励只在叶节点产生。普通 GRPO 会针对同一提示独立采样多条完整链；每条链分别消耗完整的 token 与工具调用预算，终点层面的组内比较也无法直接指出：哪一个共享的较早决策把成功续写与失败续写区分开来。

Tree-GRPO 研究能否通过改变 rollout 对象的结构，在不另行训练 process reward model 的情况下，让结果反馈提供更局部的训练信号。它构造以提示为条件的 forest，树中每个节点都是完整的 thought-action-observation agent step。每棵树先由当前策略生成一条完整轨迹，再把选中的非答案节点作为共享前缀，从这些前缀继续生成新后缀。完成的叶子带有终点答案和程序化结果分数；树成员关系使优化器既能在单棵树内比较相关叶子，也能比较同一提示下产生的全部叶子。

内存中的数据对象比答案列表更丰富。它包括提示与目标答案、tree_uid 与 node_uid、父子指针、深度、共享前缀、生成响应、information/turn mask、有效动作与搜索统计、终点 EM/F1 加格式分数，以及树内/树间相对优势。其谱系为：来源 QA 记录 → 预处理提示与 ground truth → 当前策略 ReAct forest → 检索观察 → 完成叶子 → 程序化结果 → 树相对优势 → Tree-GRPO 更新。

该工作属于 Rollout, Search, and Test-Time Trace Data 的核心案例，尽管这里的搜索发生在在线训练阶段，而不是测试时推理阶段。树拓扑、前缀复用、扩展决定、叶子保留和 rollout 预算共同决定哪些轨迹进入策略更新，以及它们携带什么监督。公开 artifact 的边界尤其关键：官方仓库发布了构造与训练代码，但没有核验到包含所选轨迹、原始树、全部分支、被拒绝叶子、逐记录奖励/优势或可重放环境状态的官方数据集。

因此，本 Card 是 L4 双语配方与审计记录，不表示 Tree-GRPO 已发布可复用的推理轨迹语料。引文、venue、论文、代码和实现行为已经核验；状态仍为 partial，因为核心运行时对象在使用后被删除而非发布，记录级 provenance 与复用权利也尚未解决。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html:
The central construction is shared-prefix tree sampling at the granularity of one complete ReAct interaction step. For each prompt, the policy first generates \(M\) independent complete chains. In each tree, the procedure randomly selects \(N\) non-answer nodes, reuses the root-to-node prefix, and generates a new suffix to another terminal leaf; this is repeated for \(L\) expansion rounds. The number of completed trajectories is

\[ M(LN+1). \]

With the default \(M=2\), \(N=2\), and \(L=1\), the forest contains two independent roots and three completed leaves per tree, for six leaves in total. Because four expanded leaves reuse already generated prefixes, the expected token/tool-call expenditure is approximately the cost of four fully independent trajectories rather than six. This is the paper’s main data-efficiency proposition: a nominal group of six completed responses is not equivalent to six independent samples, because their ancestry and marginal generation costs differ.

The released manager has a second parameter, \(K\), for how many leaves to return from each tree. It samples \(K\) leaves, prunes unselected leaves or subtrees in memory, packs the selected full responses, and later deletes the tree. Default scripts use \(K=3\), so the default three leaves in each tree are all selected. Under larger or non-default trees, however, some leaves can be discarded; neither a retained/rejected manifest nor the deleted topology is publicly released.

Feedback is terminal and programmatic. Single-hop and multi-hop QA use normalized exact match; web-agent QA uses normalized answer-token F1; invalid structure incurs a 0.2 format penalty. Tree-GRPO normalizes selected-leaf outcomes once within each tree and once across all trees for the prompt, then sums the intra-tree and inter-tree components as advantages/returns for policy learning. The intra-tree term compares continuations that share a prefix and therefore acts as an outcome-derived local preference signal. The inter-tree term compares independently rooted trees and provides a broader baseline when one small tree has little reward variation.

This mechanism is implicit process supervision, not an explicit process-label release. The paper proves a matching gradient direction between intra-tree GRPO and step-level DPO under a binary-outcome assumption, with different weighting. That analysis does not mean that step-DPO pairs, branch-point labels, or per-node rewards are materialized or published; it is also only an analytical approximation for web-agent training, where F1 is graded rather than binary.

核心构造是在单个完整 ReAct 交互步骤的粒度上进行共享前缀树采样。对于每个提示，策略先生成 \(M\) 条相互独立的完整链。随后在每棵树中随机选择 \(N\) 个非答案节点，复用从根到该节点的前缀，并生成一个新后缀直至另一个终点叶子；该扩展过程重复 \(L\) 轮。完成轨迹的数量为

\[ M(LN+1). \]

在默认 \(M=2\)、\(N=2\)、\(L=1\) 时，forest 包含两个独立根，每棵树有三个完成叶子，总计六个叶子。由于新增的四个叶子复用了已经生成的前缀，预期 token/工具调用开销约等于四条完全独立轨迹，而不是六条。这是论文关于数据效率的核心命题：名义上包含六个完整回答的分组并不等价于六个独立样本，因为它们的 ancestry 与边际生成成本不同。

公开实现还有参数 \(K\)，控制每棵树返回多少个叶子。manager 对 \(K\) 个叶子采样，在内存中剪掉未选叶子或子树，打包所选完整响应，随后删除整棵树。默认脚本使用 \(K=3\)，因此默认配置下每棵树生成的三个叶子都会被选择。不过，在更大或非默认树中，一部分叶子可能被丢弃；公开发布既没有 retained/rejected manifest，也没有被删除的树拓扑。

反馈是终点层面的程序化规则。单跳与多跳 QA 使用归一化 exact match，web-agent QA 使用归一化 answer-token F1，无效结构会受到 0.2 的格式惩罚。Tree-GRPO 先在每棵树内对所选叶子的结果归一化，再在同一提示的全部树之间归一化，最后把树内与树间分量相加，作为策略学习的 advantage/return。树内分量比较共享前缀的续写，因此可作为由结果派生的局部偏好信号；树间分量比较独立根树，并在小树内部奖励变化不足时提供更宽的基线。

这一机制属于隐式过程监督，不是显式过程标签发布。论文在二值结果假设下证明，树内 GRPO 与 step-level DPO 的梯度方向一致，但权重不同。该理论分析不表示系统实际生成或发布了 step-DPO pair、分支点标签或逐节点奖励；对于使用连续 F1 的 web-agent 训练，它也只是分析层面的简化。

title: Method
方法
html:
Training prompts come from three reported settings. Single-hop training uses 79,168 Natural Questions pairs; multi-hop training uses 90,447 HotpotQA pairs; web-agent training uses 2,000 sampled ASearcher-35K records plus 200 WebDancer records. Evaluation spans NQ, TriviaQA, PopQA, HotpotQA, 2WikiMultiHopQA, Musique, Bamboogle, SimpleQA, a 103-item text-only GAIA subset, WebWalkerQA, and BrowseComp. The repository provides preprocessing logic, but immutable source revisions, selected row IDs, the ASearcher sampling seed, file hashes, and official processed Parquets are unavailable.

The current policy is the trace generator; no separate teacher produces online trajectories. Experiments cover Qwen2.5 Base/Instruct and Llama3.2 Base/Instruct at 1.5B, 3B, 7B, and 14B. Released local-QA scripts default to Qwen2.5-3B, while the web-agent script defaults to Qwen2.5-14B. Each trajectory alternates tagged think reasoning, search actions, environment-provided information observations, and a terminal answer.

For local single-hop and multi-hop QA, the search action queries an E5 retriever over a Wikipedia-2018 corpus and receives the top three passages. Web-agent QA calls a Bing/web-search API and receives the top ten passages. An episode ends on the closing answer tag or EOS, or when it reaches the action budget: three tool calls for local QA and five for web-agent QA. The paper-run E5 index/corpus hashes, Bing responses, caches, endpoint versions, and replayable environment snapshots are not published.

Tree construction begins with \(M\) independently generated complete chains. Within each tree, the system randomly samples \(N\) nodes that have not already emitted an answer. Each chosen node contributes its complete root-to-node trajectory as a fixed prefix; the policy continues from that state until another complete answer leaf is formed. The process repeats for \(L\) rounds. Random expansion is important: the branch point is not selected by value, EM/F1, a learned critic, or a judge.

Default \(M=2,N=2,L=1\) creates six completed leaves at an expected token/tool budget comparable to about four independent trajectories. The paper studies expected budgets near 2, 4, 8, and 16 and varies \(M,N,L\) to expose the exploration/reuse trade-off. \(M\) increases independently rooted diversity; \(N\) and \(L\) increase shared-prefix reuse and the number or depth of local comparisons. Too little \(M\) concentrates trajectories around few roots, while serial \(L\) increases dependency and reduces efficiency.

The manager next samples \(K\) leaves per tree. It prunes leaves/subtrees not retained, packs the selected full trajectories and masks, assigns programmatic terminal outcomes, and passes selected responses plus tree_uid and training statistics to the optimizer. Default \(K=3\) retains all three leaves in each default tree. The returned public-facing runtime payload does not include node_uid, parent/child pointers, branch-point choices, or the complete topology, and the manager deletes the tree after packing.

Local QA leaves receive normalized exact match; web-agent leaves receive normalized answer-token F1; malformed structure receives a 0.2 format penalty. Selected outcomes are converted into an intra-tree normalized advantage and an inter-tree normalized advantage. The two are summed, broadcast over the selected trajectory’s policy tokens, and used in the GRPO objective. Tree-GRPO is implemented with Search-R1 and VeRL, AdamW, learning rate \(10^{-6}\), K3 KL coefficient 0.001, and the reported 180 local-QA steps or 34 web-agent steps/two epochs.

Released scripts use temperature 1.0, but complete top-p, top-k, seed, and per-record realized token/tool costs are unknown. The paper reports maximum response lengths of 4,096 for local QA and 8,000 for web-agent QA; released scripts set data.max_response_length to 500 and 2,000 respectively. The artifacts do not explain how the script’s per-generation limit maps to the paper-level cap, so exact budget reproduction remains unresolved.

训练提示来自论文报告的三种设置。单跳训练使用 79,168 对 Natural Questions，多跳训练使用 90,447 对 HotpotQA，web-agent 训练使用从 ASearcher-35K 抽取的 2,000 条记录加上 200 条 WebDancer 记录。评估覆盖 NQ、TriviaQA、PopQA、HotpotQA、2WikiMultiHopQA、Musique、Bamboogle、SimpleQA、103 条纯文本 GAIA 子集、WebWalkerQA 和 BrowseComp。仓库提供了预处理逻辑，但不可变来源版本、所选行 ID、ASearcher 抽样种子、文件哈希和官方 processed Parquet 均未发布。

轨迹由当前策略生成，没有独立 teacher 负责在线轨迹。实验覆盖 1.5B、3B、7B 和 14B 规模的 Qwen2.5 Base/Instruct 与 Llama3.2 Base/Instruct。公开的本地 QA 脚本默认使用 Qwen2.5-3B，web-agent 脚本默认使用 Qwen2.5-14B。每条轨迹依次包含带标签的 think 推理、search 动作、环境提供的 information 观察和终点 answer。

对于本地单跳和多跳 QA，search 动作查询基于 Wikipedia-2018 语料的 E5 retriever，并接收前三个 passage。web-agent QA 调用 Bing/web-search API，并接收前十个 passage。episode 在遇到结束 answer 标签、EOS 或达到动作预算时终止：本地 QA 最多三次工具调用，web-agent QA 最多五次。论文运行所用的 E5 索引/语料哈希、Bing 响应、cache、endpoint 版本和可重放环境快照均未发布。

树构造从 \(M\) 条独立生成的完整链开始。系统在每棵树中随机采样 \(N\) 个尚未产生答案的节点。每个选中节点把从根到该节点的完整轨迹作为固定前缀，策略从该状态继续，直至生成另一个完整答案叶子；这一过程重复 \(L\) 轮。随机扩展是方法的重要边界：分支点不是由 value、EM/F1、学习式 critic 或 judge 选择的。

默认 \(M=2,N=2,L=1\) 生成六个完成叶子，预期 token/工具预算约等于四条独立轨迹。论文研究约 2、4、8、16 的预期预算，并改变 \(M,N,L\) 来观察探索与复用的权衡。\(M\) 增加独立根的多样性；\(N\) 与 \(L\) 增加共享前缀复用以及局部比较的数量或深度。过小的 \(M\) 会让轨迹集中在少数根周围，串行增加 \(L\) 则提高依赖并降低效率。

随后 manager 从每棵树采样 \(K\) 个叶子。它剪掉未保留的叶子/子树，打包所选完整轨迹及 mask，赋予程序化终点结果，并把所选响应、tree_uid 与训练统计交给优化器。默认 \(K=3\)，因此每棵默认树的三个叶子都会保留。返回的运行时 payload 不含 node_uid、父子指针、分支点选择或完整拓扑；打包后 manager 会删除树。

本地 QA 叶子使用归一化 exact match，web-agent 叶子使用归一化 answer-token F1，结构不合法会受到 0.2 的格式惩罚。所选结果分别转换为树内归一化 advantage 与树间归一化 advantage；二者相加后广播到所选轨迹的策略 token，并进入 GRPO 目标。Tree-GRPO 基于 Search-R1 与 VeRL 实现，使用 AdamW、\(10^{-6}\) 学习率、0.001 的 K3 KL 系数，以及论文报告的本地 QA 180 步或 web-agent 34 步/两个 epoch。

公开脚本使用温度 1.0，但完整 top-p、top-k、随机种子和逐记录实际 token/工具成本未知。论文报告本地 QA 与 web-agent QA 的最大响应长度分别为 4,096 和 8,000；公开脚本的 data.max_response_length 却分别是 500 与 2,000。官方 artifact 没有解释脚本的单次生成限制如何映射到论文层面的上限，因此精确预算复现仍未解决。

title: Evidence
证据
html:
The empirical scope is broader than one dataset but still specific: eleven evaluation datasets across single-hop retrieval QA, multi-hop retrieval QA, and web-agent QA. The paper reports that Tree-GRPO improves over chain-based agent RL across these settings and studies expected rollout budgets near 2, 4, 8, and 16. These are author-reported training and evaluation results, not an independent reproduction.

Several ablations support claims about the construction mechanism rather than only the final score:

  • Agent-step branching outperforms token- or sentence-level branching in the reported Qwen2.5-3B, budget-4 comparison. This supports the paper’s decision to treat a complete thought-action-observation interaction as the process unit, but does not prove that the same boundary is optimal in every environment.
  • Varying \(M,N,L\) shows a diversity/reuse trade-off. More independently rooted trees improve exploration, while concentrating the budget in shared-prefix expansion eventually gives diminishing or degraded results. Prefix reuse is therefore not a free multiplication of independent evidence.
  • With few branches, the intra-tree baseline can have high variance and training can collapse. The inter-tree advantage is reported as an important fallback rather than a complete solution to sparse or homogeneous rewards.
  • The paper’s failed cases show early commitment to a partially satisfying path, failure to reconsider after new evidence, and an incorrect final answer. Tree structure alone does not ensure reflection or recovery.

The feedback path is directly supported by the paper, theory appendix, and official implementation: EM/F1 plus the format term scores selected leaves; leaves are grouped by tree_uid; intra-tree and inter-tree normalization produce the summed training advantages. The code also supports the release-boundary finding: selected full responses and statistics are packed for the online update, while node ancestry and the complete tree are not returned and the tree is deleted.

The theoretical result is narrower than a general process-supervision guarantee. Under binary outcomes, the paper derives that intra-tree GRPO and step-level DPO share a preference-gradient direction while differing in weight. It does not demonstrate that each shared-prefix branch point is causally responsible for the terminal result, and web-agent F1 is continuous rather than binary.

Reported benchmark performance is evidence that this training recipe affected the authors’ evaluated policies. It is not evidence that the transient trees are a high-quality reusable dataset, that the terminal verifier validates intermediate reasoning, or that missing branches and rewards can be reconstructed. No independent result bundle, raw rollout corpus, or record-level replay ledger was verified.

实证范围覆盖多个数据集，但边界仍然明确：十一项评估数据集分属单跳检索 QA、多跳检索 QA 和 web-agent QA。论文报告 Tree-GRPO 在这些设置中优于 chain-based agent RL，并研究约 2、4、8、16 的预期 rollout 预算。这些是作者报告的训练与评估结果，不是独立复现。

多项消融支持了对构造机制的判断，而不只是支持最终分数：

  • 在论文报告的 Qwen2.5-3B、budget-4 比较中，agent-step 分支优于 token-level 或 sentence-level 分支。这支持把完整 thought-action-observation 交互作为过程单元的设计，但不能证明这一边界在所有环境中都最优。
  • 改变 \(M,N,L\) 显示了多样性与复用之间的权衡。更多独立根树改善探索；如果把预算过度集中在共享前缀扩展上，收益最终会递减或下降。因此，前缀复用不能被当作独立证据数量的无成本倍增。
  • 当树内分支很少时，树内基线方差较高，训练可能崩溃。论文把树间 advantage 作为重要 fallback，而不是对稀疏或同质奖励的彻底解决。
  • 论文失败案例显示，agent 会过早坚持一条只能部分满足问题的路径，在出现新证据后仍不重新考虑，并最终给出错误答案。树结构本身不保证反思或恢复。

论文、理论附录和官方实现直接支持反馈路径：EM/F1 加格式项为所选叶子评分；叶子按 tree_uid 分组；树内与树间归一化产生相加后的训练 advantage。代码也支持对发布边界的判断：所选完整响应与统计被打包供在线更新使用，但节点 ancestry 与完整树不被返回，随后树被删除。

理论结果比一般性的过程监督保证更窄。在二值结果下，论文推导树内 GRPO 与 step-level DPO 具有相同的偏好梯度方向，但权重不同。它没有证明每个共享前缀分支点都对终点结果负有因果责任，而且 web-agent 的 F1 是连续值而不是二值。

报告的 benchmark 表现只能说明该训练配方影响了作者评估的策略。它不能证明瞬时树是高质量可复用数据集，不能证明终点 verifier 验证了中间推理，也不能让缺失分支与奖励可被重建。没有核验到独立结果包、原始 rollout 语料或记录级 replay ledger。

title: Novelty
新意
html:
Tree-GRPO’s differentiating contribution is not a new QA corpus, learned judge, or test-time planner. It couples a particular online data topology—shared-prefix trees of complete agent steps—with group-relative policy optimization. Under a fixed expected token/tool budget, the topology creates more completed leaves than fully independent sampling and makes terminal outcome contrasts available at branch-related groups.

The method differs from ordinary chain GRPO because leaves are not exchangeable independent responses. They carry an ancestry relation: some continuations share the same earlier interactions, while the \(M\) roots remain independent. This motivates two comparison scales. Intra-tree normalization asks which continuation from a related prefix did better; inter-tree normalization compares the broader prompt-level population and stabilizes cases where one small tree lacks reward variance.

It also differs from value-guided or verifier-guided tree search. Expansion nodes are sampled randomly among non-answer nodes, not ranked by a critic, correctness estimate, or learned process reward. Programmatic EM/F1 and format rules act only after a selected leaf completes. The novelty is therefore a search-to-credit assignment recipe, not an assertion that the search policy identifies the best branch online.

The paper’s structural equivalence result connects the intra-tree gradient to step-level direct preference learning under binary outcomes. Its research value is to show how an outcome-labeled tree can induce a local preference direction without separately annotated step pairs. The claim must remain bounded: explicit step labels and DPO pairs are not released, the equivalence has a weighting difference, and graded F1 lies outside the binary assumption.

For this atlas, the most important novelty is the auditable distinction among three objects: the rich in-memory agent-step tree, the selected-leaf batch used by Tree-GRPO, and the public code-only release. Treating these as the same “dataset” would erase selection, rejection, ancestry, and reward-lineage information that is essential for reasoning-data audit.

Tree-GRPO 的区别性贡献不是新的 QA 语料、学习式 judge 或测试时 planner，而是把一种特定的在线数据拓扑——由完整 agent step 构成的共享前缀树——与组相对策略优化结合起来。在固定预期 token/工具预算下，该拓扑比完全独立采样产生更多完成叶子，并使终点结果对比能够在与分支结构相关的分组上发挥作用。

该方法不同于普通 chain GRPO，因为叶子并不是可互换的独立回答。它们带有 ancestry：部分续写共享较早的交互，而 \(M\) 个根仍相互独立。因此方法引入两种比较尺度。树内归一化询问从相关前缀出发的哪个续写更好；树间归一化比较更宽的提示级样本群，并在某棵小树内部缺少奖励方差时提供稳定作用。

它也不同于 value-guided 或 verifier-guided tree search。扩展节点从非答案节点中随机采样，不由 critic、正确性估计或学习式 process reward 排序。程序化 EM/F1 与格式规则只在所选叶子完成后起作用。因此，其新意是 search-to-credit-assignment 配方，而不是宣称搜索策略能够在线识别最佳分支。

论文的结构等价结果在二值结果假设下把树内梯度与 step-level direct preference learning 联系起来。其研究价值在于说明，带结果标签的树如何在没有单独标注步骤对的情况下诱导局部偏好方向。该结论必须保持边界：显式步骤标签与 DPO pair 并未发布，等价关系的权重不同，而且连续 F1 不满足二值假设。

对本图谱而言，最重要的新意是清楚区分三类对象：丰富的内存 agent-step 树、Tree-GRPO 实际使用的所选叶子 batch，以及公开的 code-only release。把三者都称为同一个“数据集”，会抹去对推理数据审计至关重要的选择、拒绝、ancestry 与奖励谱系。

title: Limitations
局限
html:
The central trace object is not released. The implementation constructs parent/child trees with stable runtime IDs, but returns selected full responses, masks, scores/statistics, and tree_uid rather than serializing the complete topology. After packing, the tree is deleted. There is no official corpus of raw trees, selected paper-run trajectories, all branches, expansion choices, rejected/pruned leaves, node ancestry, or branch-point comparisons.

Selection and reward lineage are incomplete. Default \(M=2,N=2,L=1,K=3\) retains all three leaves per tree, but non-default configurations can sample \(K\) leaves and prune others. No retention manifest explains which trajectory was selected, unselected, invalid, pruned, or failed. Per-leaf EM/F1/format outcomes, intra-tree and inter-tree normalization groups, final advantages, policy version, optimizer update, and checkpoint are not linked in a public record-level ledger.

Outcome verification is narrow. Exact match, answer-token F1, and format checks do not verify retrieval grounding, source attribution, intermediate logical validity, or factual robustness. A correct terminal string may reward a flawed path; a valid path may be penalized by normalization or extraction. Outcome-derived credit can be assigned to an earlier branch even when later reasoning, retrieval noise, or a downstream action caused the result. The step-DPO analysis assumes binary outcomes, whereas web-agent training uses graded F1.

The environment is not replayable. Local QA depends on an E5 index over Wikipedia-2018; web QA depends on Bing/web-search responses. The exact corpus and index hashes, retrieval build, query/response logs, cache, endpoint version, and paper-run environment snapshots are unavailable. A nominally identical action can therefore receive different observations and ultimately a different reward.

Source and split provenance is partial. Named source datasets and paper-reported counts are available, but immutable revisions, exact row IDs, file hashes, the 2,000-record ASearcher sampling seed, processed Parquets, and duplicate controls are not. The repository still describes web-agent data as forthcoming. No exact-match, near-duplicate, semantic-overlap, benchmark-contamination, or search-corpus leakage audit was found.

Configuration reproduction is incomplete. Scripts disclose temperature 1, optimizer settings, and core tree parameters, but not a complete top-p/top-k/seed contract or realized per-record token/tool budgets. Paper-level response caps of 4,096/8,000 differ from released data.max_response_length values of 500/2,000, and their mapping is undocumented. There is no immutable paper-run configuration and result bundle tying tables to code versions.

Efficiency and exploration trade off. Shared prefixes reduce marginal generation cost but correlate the leaves. Too-small \(M\), too much expansion through \(N\) or \(L\), or a shallow task can reduce independent exploration and degrade results. With few leaves, the intra-tree baseline has high variance and can contribute to training collapse; the inter-tree term mitigates but does not remove that risk.

Rights and institutional metadata remain unresolved. Apache-2.0 covers the official repository code only. The paper and repository do not consolidate rights for Natural Questions, HotpotQA, ASearcher-35K, WebDancer, evaluation sets, Wikipedia-derived observations, Bing results, processed rows, or generated trajectories. Public availability is not permission to redistribute or train on those objects. The checked evidence ledger also does not verify author affiliations, so institutions.json intentionally remains unresolved rather than inferring an organization from the repository namespace.

Status remains partial, and curation remains L4 rather than L5/L6. Benchmark results do not close these release, provenance, verifier, replay, or rights gaps.

核心轨迹对象未发布。 实现构造带稳定运行时 ID 的父子树，但返回的是所选完整响应、mask、分数/统计与 tree_uid，而不是序列化完整拓扑。打包后树会被删除。官方没有发布原始树、论文运行所选轨迹、全部分支、扩展选择、被拒绝/剪枝叶子、节点 ancestry 或分支点比较的语料。

选择与奖励谱系不完整。 默认 \(M=2,N=2,L=1,K=3\) 会保留每棵树的全部三个叶子，但非默认配置可以只采样 \(K\) 个叶子并剪掉其余部分。没有 retention manifest 说明哪条轨迹被选择、未选择、判为无效、剪枝或失败。逐叶 EM/F1/格式结果、树内与树间归一化组、最终 advantage、策略版本、优化器更新与 checkpoint 没有在公开记录级 ledger 中连通。

结果验证范围窄。 Exact match、answer-token F1 与格式检查不能验证检索 grounding、来源归因、中间逻辑有效性或事实稳健性。错误路径可能因终点字符串正确而得到奖励；有效路径也可能因归一化或提取失败被惩罚。结果派生的信用可能被分配给较早分支，尽管真正决定结果的是后续推理、检索噪声或下游动作。step-DPO 分析假设二值结果，而 web-agent 训练使用连续 F1。

环境不可重放。 本地 QA 依赖 Wikipedia-2018 上的 E5 索引；web QA 依赖 Bing/web-search 响应。精确语料与索引哈希、检索构建、查询/响应日志、cache、endpoint 版本和论文运行环境快照均未提供。因此，名义上相同的动作可能得到不同观察，最终也会得到不同奖励。

来源与切分 provenance 不完整。 已知来源数据集名称和论文报告的数量，但不可变版本、精确行 ID、文件哈希、2,000 条 ASearcher 抽样种子、processed Parquet 与重复控制未知。仓库仍把 web-agent 数据描述为后续发布。已检查材料中没有 exact-match、近重复、语义重叠、benchmark contamination 或搜索语料泄漏审计。

配置复现不完整。 脚本披露温度 1、优化器设置和核心树参数，但未提供完整 top-p/top-k/随机种子契约，也未报告逐记录实际 token/工具预算。论文层面的 4,096/8,000 响应上限与公开 data.max_response_length 的 500/2,000 不同，二者映射未解释。没有把表格、代码版本、不可变论文运行配置和结果包连通起来。

效率与探索存在权衡。 共享前缀降低边际生成成本，但也让叶子相关。过小的 \(M\)、通过 \(N\) 或 \(L\) 进行过多扩展，或者任务深度太浅，都可能减少独立探索并使结果下降。树内叶子很少时，树内基线方差较高，可能促成训练崩溃；树间项能够缓解，但不能消除该风险。

权利与机构元数据仍未解决。 Apache-2.0 只覆盖官方仓库代码。论文与仓库没有汇总 Natural Questions、HotpotQA、ASearcher-35K、WebDancer、评估集、Wikipedia 派生观察、Bing 结果、处理后记录或生成轨迹的权利。公开可见不等于获准再分发或用于训练。已检查 evidence ledger 也没有核验作者 affiliation，因此 institutions.json 有意保持未解决，而不从仓库 namespace 推断机构。

条目状态仍为 partial，curation 保持 L4 而不是 L5/L6。Benchmark 结果不能填补这些发布、provenance、verifier、重放或权利缺口。

title: Usefulness
用途
html:
For Rollout, Search, and Test-Time Trace Data, Tree-GRPO is a concrete recipe for studying how rollout topology changes the amount and granularity of supervision obtained from a fixed training-time budget. A controlled follow-up can hold the prompt pool, current policy, terminal reward, and expected token/tool budget fixed while changing \(M\), \(N\), \(L\), \(K\), expansion-node sampling, and whether intra-tree and inter-tree advantages are combined.

Evidence-backed uses include:

  • implementing shared-prefix ReAct rollout generation for online RLVR or agent training and comparing it against independent chain sampling at matched generated-token, tool-call, and wall-clock budgets;
  • treating complete thought-action-observation interactions as candidate process units, then testing whether outcome-derived branch comparisons agree with explicit step annotations or causal interventions;
  • auditing the contribution of intra-tree and inter-tree normalization, including small-tree variance, all-equal-reward groups, and collapse conditions;
  • measuring the difference among nominal leaf count, independent-root count, marginal suffix generation, selected-leaf count, and truly distinct trajectories;
  • constructing a release format with stable prompt/tree/node IDs, parent-child links, expansion choices, every selected and rejected leaf, programmatic score details, group statistics, advantage values, policy version, and checkpoint linkage;
  • testing replay under pinned Wikipedia/E5 and web-search snapshots, rather than treating live retrieval as a stationary environment.

The appropriate reuse class is strong construction and audit reference; conditional implementation/reproduction; direct training-data reuse unavailable. The official code can guide a new implementation under its Apache-2.0 license, but the paper-run trace data, processed QA bundle, selected/rejected leaves, reward ledger, and environment snapshots are not released. Rights for upstream datasets, retrieval observations, and generated trajectories also remain unknown.

This Card can serve as an evaluation-design warning. The six-leaf default should be compared with about four independent trajectories at matched expected generation cost, not with six independent chains as though ancestry were irrelevant. Studies should report realized tokens, tool calls, distinct roots, expanded suffixes, selected/unselected leaves, reward variance, and wall-clock cost separately.

It can also serve as a release checklist for the assigned track. A tree-search paper becomes auditable reasoning data only when the runtime topology, feedback decisions, rejection boundary, environment state, and lineage survive beyond the optimizer step. Benchmark EM/F1 improvements alone do not establish that those missing objects are reusable, licensed, decontaminated, or high quality.

对于 Rollout, Search, and Test-Time Trace Data，Tree-GRPO 提供了一个具体配方，用于研究 rollout 拓扑如何改变固定训练预算所能产生的监督数量与粒度。后续对照研究可以固定提示池、当前策略、终点奖励和预期 token/工具预算，再改变 \(M\)、\(N\)、\(L\)、\(K\)、扩展节点采样方式，以及是否合并树内与树间 advantage。

有证据支持的用途包括：

  • 为在线 RLVR 或 agent training 实现共享前缀 ReAct rollout，并在生成 token、工具调用和墙钟预算匹配时与独立 chain sampling 比较；
  • 把完整 thought-action-observation 交互作为候选过程单元，再检验结果派生的分支比较是否与显式步骤标注或因果干预一致；
  • 审计树内与树间归一化的贡献，包括小树方差、全同奖励组与训练崩溃条件；
  • 测量名义叶子数、独立根数、边际后缀生成数、所选叶子数和真正不同轨迹数之间的差异；
  • 构建包含稳定 prompt/tree/node ID、父子链接、扩展选择、全部所选和被拒绝叶子、程序化评分细节、分组统计、advantage、策略版本与 checkpoint 链接的发布格式；
  • 在固定 Wikipedia/E5 与 web-search 快照下测试重放，而不是把实时检索当作静态环境。

适当的复用等级是：强构造与审计参考；有条件的实现/复现；直接训练数据复用不可用。官方代码可在 Apache-2.0 许可下指导新实现，但论文运行轨迹、processed QA bundle、所选/被拒绝叶子、奖励 ledger 与环境快照均未发布。上游数据集、检索观察和生成轨迹的权利也仍为 unknown。

本 Card 还能提示评估设计中的常见错误。默认六叶配置应与预期生成成本约等于四条独立轨迹的设置比较，而不能把它当成 ancestry 无关的六条独立链。研究应分别报告实际 token、工具调用、不同根、扩展后缀、所选/未选叶子、奖励方差和墙钟成本。

它也可作为本 track 的发布清单。只有当运行时拓扑、反馈决定、拒绝边界、环境状态和谱系在优化器更新后仍被保留，树搜索论文才能转化为可审计推理数据。Benchmark EM/F1 提升本身不能证明这些缺失对象可复用、已授权、已去污染或质量高。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html:
• Read Section 3.1 and Algorithm 1 together: \(M\) independent roots plus \(N\) expansions for \(L\) rounds yield \(M(LN+1)\) leaves; default \(2,2,1\) means six leaves at an expected cost near four independent full trajectories.
  • Track \(K\) separately from the construction formula. Default \(K=3\) keeps all three leaves per default tree, but the general implementation can prune unselected leaves and then deletes the tree; no public retained/rejected manifest survives.
  • Follow the full feedback path: local QA uses EM, web-agent QA uses graded F1, malformed structure receives a 0.2 penalty, and selected outcomes become summed intra-tree plus inter-tree advantages. These are outcome-derived signals, not released step labels.
  • Pair benchmark and ablation tables with the failure evidence: agent-step branching outperforms token/sentence branching in the reported setting, but small-tree variance, exploration loss, early commitment, and training collapse remain possible.
  • Before reuse, require raw trees and all branches, per-leaf reward/advantage ledgers, immutable split IDs, paper-run retrieval snapshots, complete decoding and budget logs, decontamination, upstream/derived-data rights, and institution verification. Code availability and benchmark gains do not substitute for those records.

• 应把第 3.1 节与算法 1 连起来读：\(M\) 个独立根加上每轮 \(N\) 次扩展、共 \(L\) 轮，得到 \(M(LN+1)\) 个叶子；默认 \(2,2,1\) 表示六个叶子，预期成本约等于四条独立完整轨迹。
  • 必须把 \(K\) 与构造公式分开追踪。默认 \(K=3\) 保留每棵默认树的全部三个叶子，但通用实现可以剪掉未选叶子并删除树；公开发布没有留下 retained/rejected manifest。
  • 应追踪完整反馈路径：本地 QA 使用 EM，web-agent QA 使用连续 F1，结构不合法受到 0.2 惩罚，所选结果再转化为树内与树间 advantage 之和。这些是结果派生信号，不是已发布的步骤标签。
  • 阅读 benchmark 与消融表时要同时查看失败证据：论文设置中 agent-step 分支优于 token/sentence 分支，但小树方差、探索损失、过早坚持路径和训练崩溃仍可能发生。
  • 复用前应要求原始树与全部分支、逐叶 reward/advantage ledger、不可变 split ID、论文运行检索快照、完整解码与预算日志、去污染、上游/衍生数据权利和机构核验。代码可见与 benchmark 提升不能替代这些记录。
